identity.name: Azariqa Kharijite emirate
alt_names: Qatari ibn al-Fuja'a's emirate in Fars and Kirman

predecessors.note: Captured from the Zubayrids in 685 (Second Fitna page).

successors.note: Al-Muhallab defeated Qatari in 698 (Second Fitna page).

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Azariqa row; it gives Fars and Kerman to the Umayyads in 692-697). 'For a long time, the Azariqa held Fars and Kirman' (Azariqa page); Qatari 'held parts of Fars and Kirman until ... 698' (Second Fitna page), so the whole of both is an upper bound.

region.text: Fars and Kerman, captured from the Zubayrids

ledger.note: 685: Second Fitna page: the Azariqa 'captured Fars and Kirman from the Zubayrids in 685'; Nafi ibn al-Azraq was killed c.685. The Azariqa page tells it differently: an army of the Zubayrid governor of Basra 'defeated the Azariqa in early 685' and killed Ibn al-Azraq, the Azariqa chose Ubayd Allah ibn Mahuz, were beaten by al-Muhallab at Sillabra in May 686 and only then 'retreated to Fars'. The Second Fitna year is used; the Azariqa page would put the hold at 686.

region.text: Fars and Kerman, where Qatari ibn al-Fuja'a held out

ledger.note: 698: Second Fitna page: Qatari ibn al-Fuja'a 'held parts of Fars and Kirman until al-Muhallab defeated him in 698'. The Azariqa page: 'split into two groups and were subsequently destroyed in 698-699'.

698-699: Azariqa page: after Hajjaj became governor of Iraq in 694 and reinstated al-Muhallab, the Azariqa were pushed back into Kirman and 'split into two groups and were subsequently destroyed in 698-699'. The first year is used; the Second Fitna page dates their suppression to 696-699.

wars.name: Azariqa revolt

zones.text: Iraq, raided from late 686 (al-Mada'in) until the suppression of 696-699

wars.outcome: Umayyad victory: al-Muhallab defeated Qatari in 698 and the Azariqa 'were subsequently destroyed in 698-699'.
wars.note: Azariqa page: Sillabra May 686, late 686 raid on al-Mada'in and the siege of Isfahan, Hajjaj governor of Iraq in 694. The Azariqa began as a Basran Kharijite band after 683.

certainty.note: A raiding army holding two provinces; the pages say 'parts of Fars and Kirman' and do not draw borders.

sources.title: Azariqa
sources.note: Basra, Sillabra May 686, retreat to Fars, Qatari, Muhallab and Hajjaj, destroyed 698-699.

sources.title: Second Fitna
sources.note: Fars and Kirman captured in 685, held until Qatari was defeated in 698.

notes: Written for group me-07 on 2026-10-19 from two pages. State Cliopatria lacks. No capital is named on either page (an army camp state, so the capitals list is empty). Not on the pages: the year the Azariqa passed from Fars to Kirman, their raids' dates after 686 except those given, the year Zubayr ibn Mahuz was killed, when Qatari became leader, where in Iraq they were active 691-696 (the Second Fitna page says active in Iraq until suppression in 696-699, the Azariqa page has al-Muhallab pushing them back into Kirman from 694). Rulers are not listed because the pages date none beyond Ubayd Allah ibn Mahuz (chosen in 685, killed in May 686). Not to be confused with the dossier 'kharijites' (the Kharijite imamate of Ifriqiya, 751-761).
